findings.title: Core meta-posterior conditions on F while integrating F out

assumptions_verified: F,A,O each binary with strictly positive conditional tables
Admissible submodel even when direct theta-to-O effects permitted
counterevidence: Could intend marginal target; changing LHS repairs that different inferential target
F as distribution-valued strategy does not remove conditioning/marginal distinction
Conceptual modules and normative recommendations not disproved
